heading: Engineer by training, product-thinker by practice.
paragraphs: I'm a dynamic and highly motivated software engineer with over five years of experience specializing in web applications that optimize business operations. My focus is on shipping systems that survive scale — from database design to deployment orchestration — without losing sight of the humans who use them.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science & Engineering with Cum Laude distinction from North South University. My passion for innovation and adaptability as a fast learner drive my continuous growth, and I thrive when I can leverage that curiosity to tackle complex challenges alongside forward-thinking teams.

Across my career at Axilweb, Shapla, Evident BD, and Amin Travels & Tours, I've owned features end-to-end: gathering requirements from stakeholders, architecting the data model, writing the backend, converting static HTML/CSS designs into reactive Vue interfaces, dockerizing the stack, and taking it to production. I care as much about code review and mentoring as I do about the code itself.

strengths.title: End-to-end delivery
strengths.description: From requirements analysis with stakeholders through Dockerized deployment on production servers.

strengths.title: Data-first design
strengths.description: Lead database design and optimization across PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB to keep applications fast at scale.

strengths.title: Full-stack fluency
strengths.description: Comfortable across Laravel, NestJS, Vue, Nuxt, React and Electron — right stack for the right problem.

strengths.title: Team multiplier
strengths.description: Code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and staying ahead of tech trends to raise the bar for the whole team.
